comp2.title: GNSS digital assistant
comp2.description: Designed to make satellite-navigation concepts, data formats and analytical workflows easier to explore. It supports learning, research orientation and technical problem framing through clear, structured responses.

cards.title: Explain GNSS concepts, terminology and equations
Compare SPP, DGPS, RTK, PPP and integrated-navigation techniques
Guide users through NMEA, RINEX observation and navigation files
Support receiver, signal-processing and positioning workflows
Suggest learning resources and research directions
Direct users to relevant lab facilities, programs and publications
